gloss: to be worth; to deserve; to merit

definitions.gloss: to be worth; to deserve; to merit; to be worthy of
definitions.explanation: To have enough value or importance to warrant a particular action, effort, or assessment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}する{本|ほん}だ。
examples.english: It is a book worth reading.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}する。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{称賛|しょうさん}→称賛：21287_shousan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}するものだった。
examples.english: His efforts were worthy of praise.

notes:
{値|あたい}する is a literary, somewhat formal expression meaning to be worthy of or to merit. It is typically used in the pattern ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}する (to be worth doing / to deserve). It carries a tone of considered judgment and is common in written Japanese, reviews, and evaluations.

USAGE:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}する: to be worth ~; to deserve ~
- ～⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}する: to be worth doing ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}する: to be worthy of attention
- ⟦{称賛|しょうさん}→称賛：21287_shousan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}する: to deserve praise
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}する: to be trustworthy
- ⟦{尊敬|そんけい}→尊敬：01454_sonkei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}する: to be worthy of respect
- ⟦{一読|いちどく}→一読：17764_ichidoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{値|あたい}する: to be worth a read

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{足|た}る→足る：03914_taru⟧: to be worthy of; to be sufficient — very close synonym, slightly more literary
- ふさわしい: suitable; worthy — describes general suitability rather than merit-based worthiness
- ～{甲斐|がい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be worth doing — more colloquial, emphasizes the reward felt after effort
